records.text: Owens said Val Peterson is a brigadier general and for 30 years led the state National Guard, particularly its Military Intelligence Brigade, while also employed at UVU.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And that's not all. Ladies and gentlemen, most interestingly, Val Peterson is a brigadier general. For 30 years, he led the state's National Guard, particularly the state's Military Intelligence Brigade. ... which has six units across the state. He kept this up while at the same time managing his full-time employment with UVU.

records.text: Citing a 2007 article, Owens said then-Lieutenant Colonel Val Peterson assumed command of the 300th Military Intelligence Brigade, a Utah-headquartered linguist and intelligence unit with nearly 2,000 language specialist troops in six states.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So this was when UVU was Utah Valley State College. And he, at this point in his military career, was the lieutenant colonel. So here we go. ... It tells us, by day, Val Peterson of Orem is a seasoned administrator at Utah Valley State College. ... By evening, weekend, or whenever called, he is Lieutenant Colonel Peterson (Val Peterson) at the Utah Army National Guard. During a change of command ceremony on Saturday at the Utah Army National Guard's Draper headquarters, Peterson (Val Peterson) assumed command of the 300th Military Intelligence Brigade, a linguist and intelligence unit headquartered in Utah that has nearly 2,000 language specialist troops in six states.

records.text: Val Peterson said a large majority of the brigade members had already served or were serving deployments in Iraq and Afghanistan, according to the 2007 article Owens read.
records.speaker: Val L. Peterson

appearances.snippet: A large majority of the brigade's members have already or are currently serving deployments in Iraq and Afghanistan, he said.

conveyance.original_source: 2007 article read by Owens; publication not named in transcript

records.text: Hank McIntire described Val Peterson as a Spanish linguist uniquely in touch with brigade members who combined military duties with civilian careers, and as personable and approachable.
records.speaker: Hank McIntire

appearances.snippet: Major Hank McIntyre, spokesman for the Utah National Guard, said Peterson (Val Peterson), as a Spanish linguist, is uniquely in touch with the needs of the 300th Military Intelligence Brigade members who split their military duties with civilian careers, making him a great fit. ... to fit for this new assignment. Lieutenant Colonel is a very personable, very approachable person. He personifies what the guard is, McIntyre (Hank McIntyre) said.
